game.name: Patchwork Pioneers
game.desc: a Godot 4 turn-based ranked roguelike (four stitched ragdoll heroes, each with 4 fixed signature abilities; found patches are sewn onto an ability to add an effect; no body-part abilities; dark gothic patchwork art style)
game.design_next_default: BAL NEXT MAIN STEPS: none yet; build the STITCHED_DESIGN.md stages S1a-S9 in order (open OWNER ORDER items first).
game.locked_rules: Design v4 (STITCHED_DESIGN.md): 4 heroes in ranks 1-4, SPEED+1d8 turn order, one ability per body-part slot (4), fray 0-200 with a resolve check at 100, the candle, Hanging by a thread; Bleed, Weak, Exposed, Thorns, Tangled, Blind and Riposte as GAME_DESIGN.md defines them, adapted to turns; a 12-floor run with one boss. The old card game is retired (owner 11-04): it need not stay playable; each stage deletes the card code and tests it replaces, S7 the rest.
game.design_rules: - Owner 2026-11-04: STITCHED_DESIGN.md (Design v4) replaces the card combat and outranks the card rules in GAME_DESIGN.md and MILESTONES.md; its fray (stress) system is now IN scope. Build its stages S1a-S7 in order. Still out of scope: a hamlet or town between runs, multiple acts, audio. Light run-to-run unlocks and a difficulty climb are allowed (owner 2026-10-24). No new card content, card balance or card UI. Pick 4 of 8 heroes; look-driven abilities, enemies and events; single-purpose stops; gothic ragdoll storybook art (ART_STYLE.md "Art v3").
game.art_style: Use the attached reference ONLY for the ART STYLE, never for its subjects, layout or text: a GOTHIC RAGDOLL storybook illustration of a patchwork world, grim and dreadful like a gothic horror tale told by a guttering candle (dark, oppressive, muted and desaturated, deep black shadows, small pools of warm light, worn and stained cloth, decay). Everything is a hand-sewn rag doll or stuffed toy: plump, rounded, soft stuffed shapes with chunky proportions (big round head, short sturdy limbs, never thin or spindly), big sewn-on button eyes or stitched-X eyes, visible bold running-stitch seams, mismatched patches and frayed edges. Clean, confident, smooth thick dark ink outlines (NOT scratchy, sketchy or hatched lines), painted soft cel shading with warm candle or lantern glow rim light and cool deep shadows. Fabric is shown as simple flat printed patterns (plaid, gingham, pinstripe, polka dots, stars, damask, quilted diamonds) inside the outlines, never photographed felt or fibre texture. Colours: rich deep jewel tones (plum, midnight teal, oxblood, moss, mustard, dusty rose, bone cream) on dusky backgrounds, with one glowing warm accent per image; strong light/dark contrast so it reads at a glance; use the palette given for this subject when one is given. It must NOT look like Don't Starve or Tim Burton: no sepia or brown wash, no scratchy pen hatching, no paper texture, no spindly limbs, no spiral curls, no grimy survival look. It is shown small in a game (about 96 to 160 pixels tall for characters), so use big simple shapes and an instantly readable silhouette; the prop or body part that shows what the character DOES is large and obvious. Charming and a little creepy, never gory.
game.feature_inspiration: Darkest Dungeon, Darkest Dungeon 2, Sonny 2 and Breach Wanderers
game.feature_style: cloth, stitches, thread, pins, buttons and scraps; small, data-driven and tested

art_framing.enemies: a single enemy character, full body, facing LEFT in a 3/4 view, standing ready to fight
art_framing.bosses: a single large boss character, full body, heavy and imposing, facing LEFT in a 3/4 view
art_framing.heroes: a single hero character, full body, ready pose, facing RIGHT in a 3/4 view
art_framing.backgrounds: a full-bleed wide 16:9 scene illustration (a battle backdrop or map board) with no characters and no text

game.scenarios: title = the boot screen (the game's own main scene); roster_battle = the Stitched battle opened from a fixed seed (?screen=stitched_battle). The card screens are retired (owner 2026-11-05).
game.art_style_short: Dark gothic ragdoll illustration in the attached reference's line style but far grimmer: plump stuffed rag-doll shapes with button or stitched-X eyes, bold running-stitch seams and worn, stained, torn patches, smooth thick dark ink outlines, heavy chiaroscuro with deep black shadows and small pools of warm candle or torch light, muted desaturated palette (bruised purples, dried-blood reds, sickly greens, ash greys), fog, decay and dread like a grim gothic horror dungeon crawler; NOT cute or cosy, NOT like Don't Starve (no sepia, no scratchy hatching, no spindly limbs)

art_accents.name: cross-stitch
art_accents.style: Use the attached reference ONLY for the ART STYLE, never for its subjects, layout or text: CROSS-STITCH PIXEL ART, the embroidered accent style of a gothic ragdoll patchwork world. Every pixel is one visible X-shaped cross-stitch of embroidery thread, so the image is a strict square stitch grid like a framed embroidery sampler; every shape is outlined with a row of dark backstitch, with a little thread sheen. Bold limited palette of thread colours in the main game's jewel tones (plum, midnight teal, oxblood, moss, mustard, dusty rose, bone cream, dark brown outlines); use the palette given for this subject when one is given. An icon is only about 16 to 24 stitches across with big simple shapes so it reads at a glance at small size; a map or board is stitched on cream or dusk-blue aida cloth with the faint weave holes visible, its paths as running-stitch lines and its stops as small stitched motifs. Charming and a little spooky, never gory, NOT smooth digital pixel art.
art_accents.short: Cross-stitch pixel art exactly in the attached reference's style: every pixel is one visible X-shaped embroidery-thread stitch on a strict square grid like an embroidery sampler, dark backstitch outlines, bold limited jewel-tone thread palette, big simple shapes readable at small size
